_doc: Local transport vectors for docs/remote/helper-protocol.md section 15. Read by helper/tests/fixtures.rs and tests/unit/scripts/helper-fixtures.test.ts. A vector tagged os applies on that OS only (windows, or unix for macOS and Linux); untagged ones apply on every OS. Requests are read as a connection that acked local reads them; a record or listing that is valid re-encodes to the same bytes.

hooks._doc: Hook event vectors for docs/remote/helper-protocol.md section 15 (capability hooks, from 2.1.3-beta.8). Read by helper/tests/fixtures.rs. A request is read as a connection that acked core, local and hooks reads it, unless the vector says what was acked (acked). messages and taken are the exact bytes the holder sends; largest is the largest event there can be.

largest._doc: The largest hook event: a payload of limits.payload_bytes, built as {"hook_event_name":<kind>,"prompt":"x..."} (the longest kind), sent as an event with seq and lost of 2^53 - 1. The event is event_bytes of JSON, within the 64 KiB a frame holds once the session is launched; a payload one byte larger is too-large.

mcp._doc: Tool stream vectors for docs/remote/helper-protocol.md section 15 (capability mcp, from 2.1.3-beta.10). Read by helper/tests/fixtures.rs and tests/unit/main/session-helper-protocol.test.ts. A request is read as a connection that acked core, local and mcp (the relay's ack) reads it, unless the vector says what was acked (acked). messages are the exact bytes the holder sends the app, and the app reads each as its fields say; invalid_messages are ones the app refuses. The limits on a message are for its message as compact JSON.
